description: Scripted re-run of tasks T1–T6 (five pages) and the non-visual variant of T7 (P4) on the final English EPUB, repeated on 6 November 2026 after the author block of the title page was corrected (the line 'University of West Attica' had been replaced by a second copy of the author's name). The interactive pages and the viewer are unchanged from the release of 5 November. Plus axe-core 4.10.2 on all content documents. Operator: Claude (AI agent). Keyboard events and DOM assertions in headless Chromium; this is not a human or assistive-technology test.

criteria.T1: model description present (>150 characters) for every model
criteria.T2: after unchecking every non-π part, only π parts remain checked and the live region lists only π parts as visible; not applicable where no π part exists by design (P1, P3)
criteria.T3: key 2 on the focused canvas gives an announcement starting 'Along'
criteria.T4: 3 × ArrowRight gives 'Rotated 15° right', key 0 gives 'Side view…', and no handled key reaches document listeners
criteria.T5: description states the numbers of σ and π bonds and the bond angle (reported, checked against chemistry by Claude)
criteria.T6: at least three static views with alternative text longer than 20 characters
criteria.T7_nonvisual: P4 descriptions name Plane 2 (stripes) and state the solid outline and the stripes cue
